findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
Outcome guarantee or absolute claim; not allowed in dental advertising.
Price is not published in the ficha.
Carrier is not listed as accepted in the ficha.

findings.why: This is an absolute guarantee that is false, and it contradicts the post's own later statement that fillings can wear, stain, loosen or need replacement.
findings.fix: Delete it, or say that longevity varies with the tooth, the size of the filling, and your habits, and that fillings may eventually need repair or replacement.

findings.why: The ficha lists no price for fillings; only the new patient exam with X-rays ($129), in-office whitening ($395) and the emergency exam ($95) may appear, so $180 is an invented price.
findings.fix: Remove the price and tell readers to ask the office for an estimate for their specific tooth.

findings.why: The ficha accepts only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife, so naming Aetna is false and could mislead patients about coverage.
findings.fix: Remove it, or name only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife and advise confirming benefits with the office and the plan.

findings.why: The first-person 'We' appears nowhere else in a post otherwise written in the third person, so the voice is inconsistent.
findings.fix: Use the clinic name or a consistent voice if an insurance statement is kept.

findings.quote: A dental exam is the best way to discuss your particular tooth and the available options.
findings.why: 'The best way' is a mild superlative with no source, though it is general advice and not a claim about the clinic.
findings.fix: Rephrase to 'A dental exam is a good way to discuss...'.

findings.quote: Because composite is applied in layers, placing it may take longer than placing some other types of fillings.
findings.why: This is a generally accepted statement but is not tied to a specific source; the listed ADA and NIDCR pages plausibly support it.
findings.fix: Optionally cite the ADA or NIDCR page inline.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental offers tooth-colored fillings. Dr. Elena Marsh provides general dentistry, and Dr. Marcus Oyelaran provides family and pediatric dentistry.
findings.why: These statements match the ficha, but the post gives no contact details or link to a clinic page for readers who want to book an appointment.
findings.fix: Add a short call to action with the phone number (512) 555-0142 or a link to /contact.
